Subject: Post-call: Acme - on‑prem/VPC security posture & next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning, Emily — good to meet the security and infra leads. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary from our discovery
- Acme is evaluating a Private deployment (VPC or on‑prem) to meet data residency and network isolation requirements.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 evidence, GDPR/HIPAA obligations for specific workloads, network segmentation, and an air‑gapped option for regulated projects.
- You asked for an initial vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) to start procurement + a deployment diagram showing network boundaries and traffic flows.

What Redwood can provide
- We can share our SOC 2 Type II report and the latest security whitepaper (we typically provide a redacted SOC 2 under MSA/NDA).
- Two deployment references: (1) VPC-managed private control plane + customer VPC peering, and (2) on‑prem package for air‑gapped environments. We'll provide diagrams and a checklist for firewall rules, NAT/TLS egress controls, and KMS key flow.
- For HIPAA/GDPR: we have data processing addenda and controls mapped; post‑SSQ we can map answers to specific controls.

Requested actions / next steps
1) Emily/security: please fill the attached ACI-SSQ-initial.xlsx with the first pass Qs you need us to answer (we'll iterate).
2) Redwood: Priyom to lead a 60‑minute technical deep‑dive to walk the SSQ and go over the deployment diagram options. Priyom — are you available next Tue/Wed afternoon PT?
3) I'll prepare a V1 deployment diagram (redwood-deploy-diagram-v2.pdf) and share a Drive folder with templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-diagrams

Attachments: ACI-SSQ-initial.xlsx (please use tab 'Security' first), redwood-deploy-diagram-v2.pdf (sample).

If that works, suggest we lock the deep‑dive time after you confirm availability. I'll also attach the SOC 2 redacted report once legal clears the DPA/NDA.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
